language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hello., my name is Frederick! I am getting ready for the next Husky sledding safari.
Will you help me buy equipment and accessories to get ready for the safari?
Round the prices of the items displayed to the nearest 5c. The price of the Buckle slide collar is $ 4.96.
When rounding to nearest 5c: 1c or 2c become 0c,  3c,4c,5c,6c or 7c become 5c and 8c or 9c become 10c.
$ 4.96 = $ 4 + 90c + 6c. By rounding to nearest 5cent: 6cent becomes 5cents. So, the rounded price of the Buckle slide collar is $ 4.95.
The price of the slide release buckle is 78c which equals 70c + 8c.
Applying the same reason the rounded price of the slide release buckle is 70c + 10c = 80c. Keep in mind.
Prices are always shown with the relevant currency sign $ or c. Now you try.
Oh boy! The safari is going to be great. Let's work out the cost of the equipment and accessories.
